component.name: Sillinux
component.summary: Open .studio3 designs and drive Silhouette cutters on Linux

description.p: Sillinux is a Linux-native studio and cutter controller for Silhouette cutting machines (Cameo 5 first). It opens .studio3 design files, SVG, PDF and raster images, offers vector editing, raster tracing and offsetting, prints sheets with registration marks through CUPS, and drives the cutter over USB or Bluetooth — including the fail-closed registration-mark scan before cutting.
The protocol and file format were reimplemented from hardware-verified evidence; see the project documentation. Sillinux is not affiliated with Silhouette America or Graphtec.
First packaged release: GUI, CLI, print sheet with marks, USB and Bluetooth transports, registration-mark scan and cut.
